head: 5c943f3060ba2784f8cd69458038ece2deb88a3d
assessment_scope: Complete declared fictional-bank Savia/FLUJO hackathon submission: product and pitch, implemented R0-R18 core, voice/card/release, data pipeline, ML/evaluation, analytics, development and generic FLUJO evidence. Independent repo-only instrument; five equally weighted /20 dimensions are not organizer numeric weights. Standalone generic platform certification, real-bank certification, complete 100-agent customer investigation and measured ROI are separate scopes.

dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.reason: The complete R0-R18 engine implements ordered policy and owned reads; the trusted host binds explicit consent to customer/session/conversation/query/target/snapshot, independently rereads durable receipts, fences revocation and handles uncertain writes. Fresh policy/acceptance/response/card checks pass. Generic FLUJO stays separate. Publication and action guarantees are appropriately bounded rather than production bank certification.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.reason: Real grounded customer replies, two actual bounded model reviewers, durable inquiries, a recovery-aware fleet connector, canonical registered narration and device-clock playback acknowledgment are implemented and evidenced. Generic platform source is inspectable and hash verified. Fresh inquiry/fleet/voice checks pass. Open-ended ES/PT quality and newly-confirmed-card live narration remain thin; exact 100-agent customer completion is a declared separate target.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.reason: Bronze/silver/gold contracts, typed quarantine, deterministic upserts, row reconciliation, lineage, stable customer shards, cursor isolation, writer locking and report-before-pointer publication form a substantial data product. The 5.9M-row historical manifest is scoped and synthetic regressions pass freshly. Source inventory assumes static objects and publication is not crash-durable across filesystems.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.reason: The team correctly rejects template leakage and unlearnable fraud labels, uses fixed training-only model selection, frozen ES/PT diagnostic text, keyword/raw/abstention baselines, language slices and uncertainty. Luna actual outputs independently reconstruct as 100 exact-correct/bounded-safe, tied by the deterministic oracle baseline. Labels remain AI-authored with only 8/120 automated audit coverage; the learned router still misses 3/30 human-required cases and abstention incurs 52/90 unnecessary handoffs. No broad human-validated generalization is established.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.reason: Read-only metadata extraction, HMAC privacy, workflow-intent versus verified-host outcome separation, current-slot denominators, coverage/conflict checks, paired routing uncertainty and workload-specific latency/token analysis are implemented and reproduce. Data findings directly change grounding choices. Persisted model cost, lifetime card-block outcomes, exact query linkage and pilot business outcomes remain unavailable rather than silently counted.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: The repository instructions establish an application/platform boundary before the product entry point: banking code belongs here, Banking MCP or the isolated hackathon branch; generic FLUJO main remains usable.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.verification: Inspected the separate banking source and the copied generic FLUJO interfaces; no outside repository was consulted.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: README presents a persistent unfamiliar-charge inquiry and explicitly credits two actual completed reviewers, helpful informational closure, and retained answer/suggestions.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.verification: The original receipt identifies two completed structured model workers; service implementation has disjoint bounded roles and durable owner-scoped records. Fresh service tests pass.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: README identifies the complete deterministic R0-R18 dispute flow as the foundation and dates its older combined qualification instead of treating voice as the whole product.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.verification: Read all nineteen ordered rule branches and their runtime/host boundaries; current selected core/host suite passed 811 tests.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: Voice and confirmed card protection are separately evidenced capabilities over fictional customers and a demo ledger. Asking does not write, and success requires an independently verified receipt.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.verification: Source and current card tests support no-write preparation, consent, ownership, receipt tampering, concurrency and fresh-login recovery. Live canonical voice proves guidance playback and saved-status rereads, not narration of a newly confirmed block.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.finding: The two-reviewer customer recording, 100-team-conversation architecture, 300 concurrent FLUJO reference requests and 18 live sandboxes are distinct workloads.
first_five_findings_in_discovery_order.verification: Capacity documentation preserves 217/300 first-run correctness, the 300/300 repeat, provisioning failures and the later disabled-workspace root failure; none is represented as completed 100-agent Savia customer execution.

checks.name: deployed source / protected closure congruence
checks.method: SHA-256 of current local HEAD Git object bytes, avoiding Windows checkout EOL conversion
checks.historical_core_closure: 38/39 original domain files match; banking_mcp/repository.py intentionally changed to accept ready publication manifests while retaining historical published:true support
checks.historical_full_manifest: 167/184 Git objects match, or 169/184 checkout bytes; old result is not transferred to the whole HEAD

checks.name: generic FLUJO retry smoke
checks.notes: No receipt-writing flag. Node emitted experimental type-stripping/module-type warnings. The historical 104 selected upstream tests were inspected, not rerun; packet is a subset, not a full platform build.

checks.name: frozen holdout and keyword baseline
checks.method: Called frozen_cases() and baseline_predict() without sklearn

checks.name: operating evidence reconstruction
checks.method: Called scripts/analyze_operating_evidence.py analyze(); independently recomputed published predictions/paired bootstrap intervals and request timing/token summaries, without training or provider calls

checks.name: dependency inventory and unavailable checks
checks.notes: Pytest 9 built-in subtest support executed the 37 subtests despite absence of the standalone plugin. No installs or neighboring caches were used.

checks.name: reviewer probe failures and retries
events: Initial importlib.metadata comprehension stopped at missing pytest-subtests, then a per-package inventory correctly recorded all versions/missing packages.
First inline keyword/analytics probe referenced p instead of pred in zip, causing NameError before analytics wrote an artifact; corrected probe passed 70/120 and operating reconstruction.
Initial working-byte comparison found 32 differences against the final runtime manifest. Git object comparison resolved all 32 as checkout EOL conversion; 183/183 committed bytes match.
Two guessed final-product source-manifest.json/receipt.json paths did not exist; authoritative runtime-verification.json/source-qualification.json named by README were used.

defects_and_gaps.finding: All 120 router labels remain proposed AI truth; the automated audit covers eight cases. Raw router human-required misses are 3/30; tau=.65 reduces them to 1/30 but sends 52/90 nonhuman cases to a person.
defects_and_gaps.action: Use language-speaking independent adjudicators, record disagreement, and collect a separate untouched customer-like set before changing routing/thresholds. Evaluate escalation capacity together with misses.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Broader open-ended ES/PT conversation and waveform comprehension are unqualified; canonical speech proves host transcript/PCM/playback control, not what a human heard. A live newly-confirmed card narration is absent.
defects_and_gaps.action: Add a small independently judged ES/PT end-to-end cohort, human audio checks and one consent-to-block-to-spoken-outcome customer capture on a frozen release.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Workflow usage/cost observations are in memory; operational stores lack retention. Host outcome metrics are current slots with unknown exact turn/query attribution, and lifetime card blocks are not joined.
defects_and_gaps.action: Persist bounded usage/cost and explicit event/query identity, define retention and derive lifetime ledger outcomes separately from current-slot snapshots.

defects_and_gaps.kind: preserved historical defect / separate future target
defects_and_gaps.finding: Original Portuguese selected-charge reply asked for supplied facts; a later n=1 trusted fallback restores useful facts. The attempted full fleet customer run failed on disabled provider workspace before delegation and accepted no fleet result.
defects_and_gaps.action: Preserve the historical failure, and qualify any stronger free-form/fleet claim in its own frozen integrated workload. Neither historical defect is evidence that the current tested consent/receipt engine is broken.

defects_and_gaps.finding: Static source inventories are not S3 VersionId pinning; atomic CURRENT replacement is not crash durability or an across-filesystem transaction. External reports may be partial on failure even while serving remains safe.
defects_and_gaps.action: For stronger operating guarantees, add version-pinned reads and crash/fault qualification with explicit report publication semantics.

limitations: Only this frozen repository/source and local Git objects were inspected. No previous rating files, neighboring repository, web/provider/deployment requests, installs, branch/commit changes or tracked writes.

Historical recordings and runtime receipts are evidence at their dated pins; no fresh live customer/provider run was made. Film/audio receipt/source evidence was inspected; no full film playback or human hearing assessment was performed.
Python network guards are instrumentation, not an OS sandbox; selected Python suites recorded zero external attempts. Test subprocesses and all system APIs are not universally sandboxed.
The private organizer rows and underlying private capacity histories were not recomputed; published aggregate provenance and local synthetic mechanisms were inspected.

Full UI npm/build, learned-router replay and full generic FLUJO distribution were unavailable within installed dependency/repo-only limits. Existing dated receipts remain creditable in their actual scopes.
No critical current engine/host defect was reproduced in the selected checks. This is bounded evidence, not proof of absence of every defect.
